IRON YARD -- one-time owner-directed PUBLIC v66 functional bot cleanup release, 14 November 2026.

The owner requires a real functional PUBLIC experience without prototypes.
Publish only to existing PUBLIC IRON YARD, owner Roblox user 9774173158,
universe 10775909016, root place 99189039770065.
Do NOT create another experience, a private alpha, or modify visibility,

Previous confirmed PUBLIC v65: Roblox place version 61,
source 6539826f1a92d3318e4f429d2eddec8094ee89a1.
This single release contains reviewed, tested and merged PR #109,
commit 1ebc975fdbe9864eaf3e3c087f88eb5983b56263, plus only this
one-shot release authorization marker.

The production Humanoid.Died listener now registers its existing 2.5s
corpse cleanup before invoking any failure-prone bot navigation teardown
or animation. It guards optional cleanup and death posing with pcall.
If those operations raise, the bot still relinquishes its roster slot,
letting collision-validated reconciliation replace it. Late timers
cannot delete newer replacement bots thanks to strict slot identity.
All other death choreography, hitbox behavior, scores, damage,
navigation rules and assets are unchanged.

Require successful exact-SHA push Rojo/Luau CI on main and independent
publisher checks for existing PUBLIC experience, creator, universe,
root place, source and configured authorization. Publish at most once.
Abort on a failed guard. Never claim live Android physics/FPS validation
from automated CI or Roblox Open Cloud success alone.
